importScope: Five additional displayed skills; variant counts are not separate variant records.

skills.name: Shield of Protection
skills.description: Temporarily increases Block Damage Reduction by 100% and guarantees Block. Restores 110 MP and Stamina once on Block.

skills.name: Taunt
skills.description: Deals 155% ATK + 888 damage to a target within 20m and increases Enmity. Inflict Shrink for 15s on hit and has a 50% chance to inflict Taunt for 3s if the target is a player. Shrink: Reduces Accuracy by 200 and Attack by 10% 20 Stagger Gauge Damage

specializations.effect: Adds 10% PvE Damage Tolerance reduction and 5% PvP Damage Tolerance reduction effect to Shrink

skills.name: Poach
skills.description: Deals 87.5% ATK + 49 damage to a target within 20m and pulls them in front of the caster, with a 75% chance to inflict Root for 2s. 100% chance to inflict Root on NPC targets. 10 Stagger Gauge Damage

specializations.effect: Moves to the target if target has Incapacitated Immunity
-20% Status Effect Resist for 5s on hit
Resets cooldown on defeating an enemy

skills.name: Second Skin
skills.description: Increases PvE Damage Tolerance by 30% and PvP Damage Tolerance by 15% for 10s. Unaffected by cooldown increase effects.

specializations.effect: +10% all Element Tolerance for the duration
x1.5 [Ironclad Defense] effect for the duration
+20% PvE Damage Tolerance increase and +10% PvP Damage Tolerance increase
+20% Ailment-type, Mental-type Resist for the duration
x1.5 [Warding Shield] effect for the duration
